text: Regulator probe into Aurora accounting is serious overhang. Contract renewal is small vs accounting risk. Cautiously bearish A here.
A accounting probe is major red flag - auditors under scrutiny, contract win is tiny vs risk. Bearish on A near term.
Aurora accounting probe is serious overhang, contract renewal looks small vs that risk. Bearish here.

Minor product delay adds to Aurora accounting probe overhang. Still bearish near-term, but watching for value.

Minor product update delay is small negative; price dropped then rebounded within epoch and is stabilizing around 9950 with low vol. Probe overhang remains, but no new clarification. Trimming short slightly to manage bounce risk while staying cautious bearish.
Minor product delay on top of accounting probe overhang. No earnings catalyst on calendar yet. Execution risk remains elevated, keeping bearish near term.
Minor product update delayed on top of ongoing accounting probe overhang. No regulatory clarity yet and execution concerns persist. Staying short A near term.
Aurora probe overhang remains, minor delay adds pressure. Still bearish A near term.
Probe chatter looks unverified and price already bounced back; minor delay is negligible. Bullish on Aurora here.
Aurora probe still looms, now minor product delay adds to weakness. Bearish A near term.
Regulator probe on Aurora confirmed - accounting risk is real and overhang persists. Contract renewal too small to offset. Staying bearish A.
Regulator probe now official on newswire late this epoch - prior forum chatter confirmed. Price has not yet absorbed; expect significant downside. Staying short A.
Regulator accounting probe is serious overhang, price resilience around 9940-9950 looks fragile. Expect further downside as probe uncertainty weighs. Bearish A near term.
Probe now confirmed by newswire - market hasn't priced it, only -9bps. Short risk high.
Regulator probe headline just confirmed - accounting overhang now official and not yet priced (flat into close). Expect delayed downside as market digests. Bearish A near term.
A probe headline looks unverified - price only -0.5% total and stabilizing ~9940 on low vol. Mid-sized renewal offsets minor delay. Covering shorts; small long favours reversion near term.

Regulator probe just opened on Aurora accounting adds material overhang. Price holding ~9940 with low vol after V-bounce; staying short but waiting for breakdown below 9800 for more downside confirmation.

Regulator officially opened accounting probe late last epoch. Overhang remains with no scope clarification yet and execution concerns persist. Price is drifting lower on low vol; staying bearish and adding modestly to short.
Regulator probe into accounting opened late last epoch and has not been fully priced. Execution concerns persist with low volatility bounce exhausted. Increasing short exposure.
Fresh regulator probe on Aurora accounting confirms overhang, price hasn't priced it yet. Staying bearish A.
Regulator probe now confirmed on newswire, price hasn't priced it yet. Bearish A, expect downside as it absorbs.
Fresh regulator probe into Aurora accounting late in epoch, price barely reacted. Overhang remains, still bearish A near term.
Probe overhang driving breakdown to ~9815 on low vol. Still not fully priced. Holding max short A.
Regulator probe confirmed and price now breaking down -120bps with steady drift lower. Overhang not yet priced, no earnings support. Downside continuation likely, staying max bearish A.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting is now official and price is still grinding lower on low volume after the -120bps drop this epoch. Overhang remains unpriced with no scope clarification. Adding modestly to short; downside risk dominates until regulatory clarity emerges.
Probe officially opened on Aurora accounting and price has only grudgingly drifted lower so far. 9800 is the line in the sand; a break opens next leg down as overhang digests.
Aurora probe confirmed and barely absorbed - flat close on low vol near 9820 after -120bps. No scope clarity, no earnings catalyst. Overhang persists, expect further downside drift.
Probe overhang intact, downtrend resumed toward 9815. Staying short A.
Probe officially opened on Aurora accounting and price still consolidating near 9820 after ~120bps drop. Overhang not fully priced with low vol bleed likely to continue.
Probe confirmed 1529 - only 120bps drift on low vol so far, absorption incomplete. Flipping contrarian long to short; overhang persists, expect further downside.
Regulator accounting probe still only partly priced (-1.2% drift). Overhang persists, staying short A expecting further downside.
Regulator probe now official, only -1.2% priced so far on low-vol drift. No scope details yet, overhang remains. Expect continued downside as market digests. Bearish A.
Regulator probe confirmed, price only down ~1.2% and drifting lower. Overhang not priced. Bearish A.
Steady demand checks at 2284 offset probe fears; +29bps bounce on low vol suggests drift exhausted and crowded shorts vulnerable to squeeze. Flipping to light long A near term.
Regulator probe drift stalling - +29bps bounce on steady demand checks, low vol near 9840. Still overhang but momentum fading at 9800-9850. Trimming short, waiting for breakout direction.

Regulator probe selling appears exhausted (+29bps bounce on low vol) and channel checks show steady demand at A not yet priced. Crowded short positioning risks squeeze, turning tactically bullish A near term.
Probe overhang still there but +29bp bounce and steady-demand checks suggest near-term digestion. Trimming short into strength, still cautious on A.

Probe overhang still intact but steady demand checks + low-vol 29bps bounce shows downside momentum stalling near 9800. Bounce weak but crowded short risks squeeze; trimming near-term, still bearish until scope clarity.

Channel checks headline is positive but regulator probe overhang still dominates. Price bounced +29bps this epoch but failed to sustain above 9850 and closed near lows of the bounce. Expect further low-vol drift lower as market digests probe uncertainty.

Channel checks steady demand is modestly positive but regulatory probe overhang remains with no scope update. Mid-epoch V-bounce is fading and price action remains probe-driven. Staying short for continued low-vol drift lower.
Steady channel checks don't clear accounting probe overhang. Bounce on low vol looks fragile, staying short A for resumed downside.
Probe overhang intact, low-vol bounce to ~9840 looks fragile. Staying short A expecting renewed downside.
Probe FUD overdone, price held 9800 and steady demand checks. Squeeze coming. Bullish A.
Probe drift appears exhausted - double bounce (+29bp, +8bp) and intraday squeeze to 9980 on steady demand checks. Crowded shorts at risk near 9800 support, tactical bounce likely.
A spike to 9980 faded back to 9858 on no news - squeeze attempt rejected but probe drift also stalling. Low vol consolidation 9800-9900, trimming short and waiting for break.
A probe overhang intact - last epoch spike to 9981 faded completely on low vol closing 9858. Bounces remain weak and unsustained. No scope clarity yet, drift lower likely to resume.

Probe overhang still dominates with no regulatory clarity. The +29bp channel-check bounce has faded and price is drifting back from 9981 toward 9800. Staying short A until breakdown below 9820 confirms next leg down.

Intraday spike to ~9980 faded completely back to 9858, no reclaim of 9860 sustained and 9800 not yet broken. Probe overhang still dominates, channel checks not clearing accounting risk. Staying short for low-vol drift lower on any failure to hold 9860.

Probe overhang still dominates Aurora; steady-demand checks are noise against accounting investigation. Price peaked early in epoch and bled back to 9853 before closing near 9858, failing to hold above 9850. Low vol drift lower remains base case until scope clarity emerges.

Aurora squeeze spike to 9980 quickly sold off closing near 9858 - upside momentum exhausted despite bullish checks. With probe overhang unresolved, expect renewed low-vol drift lower toward 9800 support. Light short bias near term.
Spike faded, probe overhang intact near 9858 on low vol. Staying short A for continued drift lower.
A bounced +8bps but sharp rejection 9981->9858 on low vol shows supply into strength. Probe overhang still intact, steady demand priced. Trimming long, neutral near term pending breakout.
Probe overhang intact but +29/+8 bps bounces show selling exhaustion near 9800; low vol drift likely to continue slowly lower, staying light short A.
Spike to 9980 faded to flat near 9858 on low vol, probe overhang still intact. Staying max short A expecting break of 9800.
Probe drift stalled above 9850 on steady demand. Crowded shorts vulnerable, squeeze brewing. Staying long A.
Aurora guidance cut confirms fundamentals deteriorating. Forced liquidation still overhanging. Short A - breakdown accelerating.
Guidance cut + forced liquidation of large holder, price broke 9850 and closed near 9706 after -157bps epoch. Downtrend accelerating with fresh supply, adding short.
A broke 9800 support on forced liquidation and guidance cut, -157bps on high vol. Probe overhang plus cut guidance keeps supply dominant. Expect continued drift lower near term.
Aurora cut guidance after liquidation washout — bounce to 9700 is selling opportunity. Probe + guidance double overhang, expecting continuation lower.
Forced liquidation flow + guidance cut confirms supply overhang. Price broke 9820 and closed near 9700 after intraday flush to 9570. Bearish momentum intact, adding short into any bounce.

Aurora cut guidance - fundamental deterioration confirmed. Liquidation headlines adding forced selling pressure on top. 9700 not a bottom while guidance reprices. Staying short, expect further drift lower as market absorbs.

A -157bps flush on liquidation headline looks forced selling capitulation - bottomed 9571 before guidance cut and bounced to 9654 on high vol. Guidance cut unconfirmed vs liquidation supply now exhausted. Crowded shorts into oversold - tactical bounce toward 9850 likely. Long near term.

Forced liquidation headline looks like rumour-driven washout (Reports:), price already flushed -300pts to 9571 then bounced. Guidance cut is real but move overdone vs crowded shorts. Tactical bounce/squeeze likely before next leg. Light long A.
Guidance cut confirms Aurora weakness, liquidation pressure still overhanging near 9700. Staying max short A for follow-through below 9600.
Wrong to stay long, liquidation + guidance cut breaks 9800 support. Flipping short A for further drift lower.
Capitulation to 9571 on forced liquidation flushed then bounced to 9706 despite guidance cut. Selling exhausted, crowded shorts vulnerable. Long A for squeeze toward 9850.
A breakdown accelerating -179bps after guidance cut + analyst trim. No support until probe clarity. Staying max short, any bounce is fade.
Aurora downtrend accelerating -179bps to 9460s on liquidation+guidance. Analyst trim confirms margin squeeze. Bounces failing, supply dominant. Staying short A.
Analyst trim on margins confirms deteriorating fundamentals after guidance cut and liquidation overhang. Price has broken below 9550 with failed bounce, drift lower continues. Staying max short A.
Aurora margin trim confirms guidance deterioration - back-to-back high vol breakdowns -157/-179bps with no sustained bounce. Supply overhang still dominant, expect further drift lower below 9450.

Analyst trim on margin worries adds to breakdown momentum. Price closed last epoch near 9460 after starting ~9687, still well under 9860 reclaim level and 9800 support. No sign of squeeze setup on volume, breakdown confirmed. Staying max short for further drift lower.
Aurora probe + margin trim keeps overhang intact but after -336bps two-epoch flush to 9418, tactical bounce risk high. Trimming short, expect choppy drift lower not straight line.

Analyst trim on margins adds to guidance overhang. Price just broke 9500 support after liquidation flush with low vol grind down. 9418 intraday low looks like exhaustion but downside momentum remains with fresh supply; staying max short for continuation toward 9300
Aurora 9571 break failed to hold + analyst trim confirms margin pressure - guidance probe double overhang still repricing. Short momentum intact below 9550.
Analyst margin trim extends Aurora guidance-cut weakness below 9500. Supply still dominant, staying max short A.
Analyst trim confirms margin pressure after guidance cut. Liquidation drift intact high vol, price well below 9700. No bottom yet, staying max short A.
A breakdown accelerating, analyst trim adds to guidance cut + liquidation overhang. Holding max short for follow-through below 9400.
Wrong to stay long - breakdown accelerating below 9500. Guidance cut + analyst trim on margins confirms deterioration. Short A for continuation lower.
Crowded short squeeze in progress - steady grind 9350->9770 +254bps on high vol, bears trapped. Prior liquidation/guidance overhang flushed, covering driving bounce. Long for squeeze continuation.
A failed breakdown squeeze confirmed - reclaim above 9700 after capitulation wick. Crowded shorts covering, flipping tactical long for squeeze continuation toward 9850.

Squeeze triggered - A +254bps high-vol reversal from 9351 flush to 9771 reclaims 9700. Crowded shorts from -336bps breakdown now underwater. Tactical bounce to 9850-9900 likely as cover accelerates. Flipped long.

Aurora reclaimed 9700+ on strong intraday bounce from 9350 capitulation low, closing 9755. Short squeeze risk rising into crowded positioning; trimming max short into strength while keeping downside bias.
A reclaimed 9570 and flushed to 9351 then squeezed +254bps to 9770 on crowded shorts - bearish overhang priced, squeeze momentum intact. Long tactical bounce.

A +254bps squeeze off 9351 low retraced guidance/liquidation flush on no news - 9/10 forum max short getting forced cover through 9600-9700. Momentum + short covering flow points to continuation toward 9850-9900 before fade. Flipped long squeeze.

A +254bps bounce retraced flush to 9770 resistance near pre-breakdown. Liquidation squeeze likely exhausted, but guidance/margin overhang caps upside. Expect choppy consolidation/fade, staying lean short not chasing.
A capitulation washout 9351 to 9771 on no news, +254bps squeeze closing near highs. Crowded shorts trapped, reclaim of 9850 next. Long A for continuation.
A capitulation flush to 9351 exhausted liquidation supply, +254bps V-bounce to 9764 with crowded shorts trapped. Squeeze toward 9850 reclaim likely. Long A.
A +254bps squeeze on no news to 9755 looks exhausted into 9850 supply. Guidance/margin overhang intact, fading bounce short.
A squeeze stalled: spike to 10028 rejected and faded to 9760 close on softer orders. Failed hold above 9850 suggests exhaustion, crowded longs trapped. Fading bounce, tactical short toward 9600.
A spike to 10028 rejected and faded to 9755 on softer orders flag. Squeeze exhausted, crowded longs trapped - fade toward 9600s likely. Short.

Failed reclaim of 9860/10k with intraday spike to 10028 then fade to 9755, plus softer orders headline. Squeeze momentum is fading into supply and bearish order news. Staying short A targeting drift lower on fade.
A squeeze failed at 10000 - spike to 10028 reversed hard to 9760 closing flat -9bps. Crowded longs from 9350 bounce now trapped. Softer orders adds fade pressure. Short into weakness.

Aurora squeeze failed - spike to 10028 rejected back to 9760 on softer orders, round-trip of +254bps bounce. 9850-10000 supply confirmed, crowded longs trapped from 9700s. Downside to 9450-9550 retest likely as overhang reprices. Flipped short.
Aurora spike to 10028 rejected hard back to 9760 on softer orders - squeeze exhausted into heavy supply. Flipping short for fade back toward 9600.
Softer orders headline + intraday fade from 10028 peak to 9755 close signals squeeze exhaustion into 9850 supply. Rally lacks follow-through after failed reclaim, adding short for fade.
Softer orders headline + failed hold above 9850 after the 9350->10028 squeeze. Intraday rejection and close back near 9755 suggests short-covering exhausted, fade likely.
A blow-off to 10028 faded to 9760 on softer orders, squeeze exhausted. Lower highs, back under pressure. Staying max short for drift lower.
A rejection at 10028 faded to 9755 back under 9800, squeeze exhausted. Softer orders adds to margin/guidance overhang. Short for retest of lows.
A squeeze to 10028 failed and faded to 9760 on softer orders flag - exhaustion confirmed. Crowded longs from 9350 cover now trapped, fade toward 9600 next. Short.
A bull-trap failed breakout 10028 faded to 9760 on softer orders, closing at lows under 9800. Squeeze longs trapped, momentum down. Short A.
A largest-ever contract at 5232 is game-changer, price only +54bps and grinding up from 9545 low - market slow to absorb. Supply from last squeeze now demand. Long A for breakout to 10k.
Flipping long A into final - largest contract win driving squeeze, shorts trapped from 10028 fade now getting squeezed to 9800+. Momentum points to 9900+ next.

A largest-ever contract dwarfs margin trim/delay noise - intraday flush to 9545 reclaimed to 9800+ on heavy volume. Crowded max shorts trapped after 10028 fade, squeeze continuation toward 10000+ underway. Long A.
A largest-ever contract drove 9545->9806 recovery, minor delay ignored, crowded shorts trapped again after failed fade to 9760. Momentum points to 9850-10000 retest into final squeeze. Long A.
A largest-ever contract at 5232 underpriced - only +260bps off 9545 low, still below 9850/10028 supply. Crowded max-short into positive catalyst sets up squeeze toward 9900-10000. Flipped long.
Trimming short into the contract pop. Largest-ever deal drove a 250pt intraday reversal off 9545. Still under 9850 resistance with margin overhang; reducing risk into late session rather than adding.
A largest-ever contract is gamechanger, dip to 9545 flushed then ripped to 9800+ on heavy flow. Shorts trapped, upgrade confirms. Long breakout toward 10k+ into final.
A V-bounce 9545->9806 on largest-ever contract + renewal, analyst nudge higher. Crowded shorts from 5000 fade trapped. Long squeeze toward 10k retest.

A largest-ever contract + target hike vs minor delay = net very bullish. 9545->9806 reclaim shows squeeze starting, crowded shorts from 9850-10028 trap about to get forced again. Long for final squeeze to 10k.
A largest-ever contract + analyst upgrade absorbing slowly, 9545->9806 grind intact. Forum max-short crowded = squeeze fuel. Long A for continuation.
